title: Female Warrior with Warhammer
description: A muscular female warrior with long black hair in a high ponytail stands in a dynamic combat stance, gripping a large ornate warhammer. The hammer's head is engulfed in swirling purple energy and crackling lightning effects.
prompt: A fierce female warrior with dark skin and long black hair tied in a high ponytail, wearing white and purple tribal-style armor with exposed midriff, stands in a powerful combat stance holding a massive ornate warhammer with both hands. The head of the hammer is surrounded by swirling purple magical energy and bright electric lightning arcs. She has purple arm guards, leg wraps, and boots. Solid dark gray background, dynamic angle, digital fantasy illustration style.
